pre_update_notes: A patch on top of 2.0.7: orders, invoices, payments and emails were reviewed end to end — storefront orders now get an invoice number when paid, one confirmation email per order (bank transfers get payment instructions first), emails and invoices in the customer's language, unpaid orders cancel themselves, and paid orders that are cancelled are refunded or their card hold released. It applies 1 small additive database migration (a language column on orders) — nothing in your products, orders or customers is changed or removed. Update from a single browser tab and leave the update page open until it finishes.
post_update_notes: After the update: (1) open Settings → Checkout & Payments → Allowed Payment Methods and tick every method you want customers to see — Paysera is hidden until you tick it. (2) Unpaid bank-transfer orders now cancel after the 'Bank Transfer Payment Limit' (48 h) and unpaid card/Paysera orders after 'Card / Online Payment Limit' (24 h, Settings → Orders Policy); this needs the scheduler cron to be running. (3) Press 'Test Paysera Connection' to see which payment methods your Paysera project offers. No new permissions were added.
